question: On what specific day and with what mantra-empowered substance is the next preparation made?
premises: The day is the dark fourteenth on a Tuesday
The ashes are empowered by mantra muttering
inference: On the dark Tuesday fourteenth, one uses corpse ashes empowered by mantra muttering
plain_english: On the dark fourteenth day falling on a Tuesday, using corpse ashes over which mantras have been muttered.
